articles.title: Body of 10th woman found in South Africa as killings investigation continues - AP News
articles.description: South African police say another woman’s body has been found near Johannesburg, bringing the number of victims in a series of killings under investigation to 10. Police began investigating after three women’s bodies were found near one another in Ekurhuleni m…
articles.content:
JOHANNESBURG (AP) South African police said Saturday that another womans body had been found near Johannesburg, bringing to 10 the number of victims in a series of killings under investigation.
